title: snapjudge judge-request-v1
description: One `snapjudge judge --json` invocation, protocol major 1 (redesign §8). Exactly one of `definition` (inline, validated like definition-v1; its `site_id` must equal the request's) and `definition_ref` (a registered id plus the exact revision of the project-first resolved definition). `state` is validated against the definition's input schema before any provider call; requests carry no thresholds or budgets. At most 1 MiB. Rejections map to reason codes: malformed or bad envelope `invalid_request`, other major `protocol_mismatch`, definition or site binding `invalid_definition`, state `invalid_input`.

timeout_ms.description: Requested deadline; defaults to 1500 and is capped at 30000 and by local configuration.
